[attribute-x-size]
=== `@x-size` X Size of the Glyph

The pixels per row in the bit-mapped glyph that has been declared with a <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element as part of a <<element-private-char,`<private-char>`>> element.

#### OPTIONAL on element:  <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>>

|===
| Value| Meaning

| A number| An integer number of pixels, for example, “`45`”,
                        that is the number of pixels in each row of the bitmap of the <<element-glyph-data,`<glyph-data>`>> element.
| Restriction| This is an optional attribute; there is no default.
|===
